sentence: The room's organizing restates in the model's terms—a member spots and proposes the N (R01, P01, P02), the room templates and builds it (P03, P04), keeps and defends it (P05, P09, P14), works out borders and help with neighbours (P07, P08, P16), and marks and records it (P11, P12)—and none of the unused concepts (c0001, c0037, c0039, c0043, c0047, c0049) shows organizing the model lacks or contradicts.

The room's organizing restates in the model's terms—a member starts the N (R01), the room calls and shows coordinates and a template (P01, P03, P04), settles the mark and moves it off Purdue (P02), keeps, defends and celebrates it (P05, P11), and trades borders and welcomes the Big Ten neighbour (P08, P07, P16)—but its naming and public shaming of repeat defacers in their own college subreddits carries a sanction the model lacks.
